Same per-frame anchor convention as goblinthrower (see its config basis); charge/warning effect frames likewise carry their own positions [-164,-343]/[-164,-327]/[-40,-32].
anchor_convention.evidence: verify monster_taubeast.json animations[*].frames[*].position; behavior_mapping 'charge1/charge2/fullcharge1 contain zero body frames - they are pure effect overlays'
